recommendation: Fix HL7/kindling ProfileGenerator so the DefinedStringPattern snapshot value type uses type.getFHIRPathType() rather than hard-coded System.String, publish or use a corrected Kindling version, then rebuild FHIR to align the snapshots with the already-correct differentials.
issue_request: FHIR-28586 is a Published/Persuasive R4 technical correction applied for R5 requesting that unsignedInt.value and positiveInt.value StructureDefinition type codes change from http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.String to http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.Integer.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied: the generated R5/current differentials expose positiveInt.value and unsignedInt.value as System.Integer, and source/datatypes/primitives.xml defines both as integer-based JSON number primitives. The generated snapshots still expose System.String, matching the Jira comment that this is a snapshot generator problem.
additional_context: The FHIR build depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling, and HL7/kindling ProfileGenerator uses type.getFHIRPathType() for DefinedStringPattern differentials but hard-codes System.String for the corresponding snapshot value element. Linked Zulip threads and MnM minutes confirm the WG intent to use System.Integer while preserving positiveInt/unsignedInt in the structuredefinition-fhir-type extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No HL7/fhir source file was changed because changing generated history files or duplicating primitive metadata in this checkout would not fix the authoritative current build output.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the FHIRPath type code system/value set context for ElementDefinition.type.code but did not resolve the positiveInt/unsignedInt snapshot mismatch.
Discussed JSON representation of integer-like primitives and was cited in the originating Zulip thread; it does not change the FHIRPath type-code decision for FHIR-28586.
Requested known-issues/errata visibility using the unsignedInt/positiveInt StructureDefinition error as an example.
